notes.title: KAKUDO - Update 2.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="-49PiG_3HAI;full"][/previewyoutube]

🔄 Gameplay Flow
All game modes are now unified into a single, seamless progression.
No more mode selection – just focus on playing.
[hr][/hr]🖥️ Engine Upgrade
Migrated to Unreal Engine 5
Expect better performance, modern rendering, and more visual depth.
[hr][/hr]🎨 Visual Enhancements
Improved lighting and post-processing

Sharper textures and cleaner visuals

Subtle effects added for a more immersive atmosphere
[hr][/hr]🎮 New Control System
Controls have been redesigned for clarity and ease of use

Better input responsiveness

Updated prompts and interface elements
[hr][/hr]⚙️ Optimization & Loading
Significantly faster loading times

General performance improvements across all systems
[hr][/hr]🧹 Bug Fixes
Fixed rare softlocks during level transitions

Resolved camera glitches in specific sequences

Audio adjustments in certain areas

General stability improvements
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for playing KAKUDO.
This update is a step toward a smoother, more immersive journey — and there’s more to come.



Maxim

notes.title: The game is out now!
notes.content:
The wait is finally over! KAKUDO is available right now! 🥳

Let yourself be carried away by the waves 🌊

🚨 To celebrate the release, the game is launched with a 15% discount ! 🚨

This is a quick reminder of the key features : 


 Single Player Game with 50 unique mazes and find their secrets 
 Emotional and engaging background story as you progress through the game
 A new haïku (japanese poetry) at the end of each level
 Three game modes in first and third-person view : story, time attack & high score
 Playable with both mouse/keyboard and gamepad
 Colorful low poly graphics rendered using Unreal Engine 4
 Relaxing atmosphere and intuitive gameplay
 Designed for puzzle lovers with a limited game time on their hands


I really hope you like the game and have a good time with it! 

See you soon
-Maxim

At the same time, I optimized the loading one more time and reduced the size of the game.

Of course, I corrected a few bugs and took the time to improve a few things.

I got one last thing... Nvidia DLSS is now available. You can find the parameters under the "display" section.

Patch notes :

Add time and date to the main menu.
Optimization of the UI code.
HUD has an active camera indicator.
The level 5 haiku is now displayed correctly.
Improved animation of the highlights.
Optimization of the game's loadings.
Enhanced game data containers.
Reduced game size.
Addition of Nvidia DLSS.
Various improvements to be up to date with the future release of the game.


See you soon!

- Maxim

notes.title: The demo is out now!
notes.content:
It's time! It is with pleasure that I announce the release of the KAKUDO demo.

In terms of content, you will be able to play 5 levels, each containing 3 game modes (which makes 15 playable levels!).

Discover the history of KAKUDO and explore these different levels!

About the demo
Attention, this is a demo, so some elements are not present. Here is what is missing for the moment:

 Ray tracing is disabled
 Nvidia DLSS is absent
 You cannot change the language (the demo is only available in English)
 The introduction cinematic is not in the final style (hand drawn) but in-game
 The dubbing of the cinematic is not included. Therefore, the slider of the voice setting is disabled.


These different elements will of course be included when the game is released.

I'm really looking forward to your feedback, feel free to step by the game's Steam community to tell me what you think!

- Maxim
